## What is not here

Everything else in the corpus. `theory/` is roughly 2,500 lines of
governing statement and `corpus-import/` is 928 files; what this page
lists is what has been re-derived, which is a small fraction of what has
been asserted. That gap is the work, not a defect — see `FRONTIER.md`
§5 for what would close parts of it.

A claim's absence from this page means nobody has checked it yet. It does
not mean it is wrong.
